full_page.content:
1933, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 129 Cont.
July
Wm. Brown - 36 - "Isle of Lost Souls ..... "
Mrs. E. Kulwicke - 35 - Threatened T.B. Enrolled yesterday when enrolled - Here To-day.
Mrs. Anna Quell - 43 - double cataracts, hard of hearing, discou- raged - hearing improving.
Florian Kreachnicki - 43 - left side paralized. Receives "Every Easter"; Promises weekly.
July 31 Mrs. A. Kivilahan - 70 - III. O. - Enrolled June 25 for diabetis - gangreenous foot, anxious, now O.K.
Mrs. A. Fuhrman - 52 - breasts lost.
Undertaker Leahy - Providence Hosp. Rhum.
James Mahaffy - 5 - badly burned ...
Mrs. Rooney - 52 - stroke To-day - anxious.
Chas. Eyers - 54 - infected eye - Just joined Church ... now threat- ened operation.
Little Edw'd Collins - 10 - Sarcomic Knee 7 yrs.
Tho's Gorges - 58 - Heart ....
Gert Popeney - 49 - of three little ones - tumor operation to-mor- row.
Lucille Glower .....
Tho's H. Hobs - 43 - desperate cancer - rect ....
Blank Page
1933, August
Page 130 Page 131 Aug. 9 Jos. W. Carey - 43 - (hunch-back) Enrolled in Ser. Mass A. May 6th - on his back then 16 mo. - doctors proposing to put him in body- cast. Comes To-day Aug. 4 able to walk with cane.
Edw'd - 14 mo. - no eyes .... Happy baby ....!
Benn Ancona - 44 - wife & 5 - dumb & paralyzed ....
Charles McFall - 29 - infected eye. Harry Kittle - 57 - mental ... . threatened.
